prompt.withSkill:
Install Muvloom so I can generate images from here.

1. Install: run `{{install}}`
2. Make muvloom available in this terminal: run `{{path}}`
3. Install the skill: run `{{skill}}`
4. Connect my account: run `muvloom auth login --no-wait`, send me the link and code it prints; after I authorize in the browser, run `muvloom auth login`
5. Run `muvloom auth status` and confirm the state is ready
prompt.workbuddy:
Connect Muvloom inside WorkBuddy so I can generate images from here.

1. Install: run `{{install}}`
2. Make muvloom available in this terminal: run `{{path}}`
3. Connect my account: run `muvloom auth login --no-wait`, send me the link and code it prints; after I authorize in the browser, run `muvloom auth login`
4. Run `muvloom auth status` to confirm the state is ready, then `muvloom capabilities` to see the models I can use

Do not run `muvloom skill install`. This release only accepts `--host claude-code` or `--host codex`.
